title: A Choir for the Veil
author: Theo Ishikawa
blurb: Casper Ishikawa, a thief who steals memories, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
